title: The Smith normal form of Laplacian matrices of simplicial annuli and high dimensional trees
summary: Inspired by the generalization of the formula of determinant of the distance matrix of trees to $k$-trees, we study the Smith normal form of Laplacian matrices associated with some simplicial complexes. We find relations between sandpile groups of adjacency graphs and the Smith normal form of Laplacian matrices of simplicial complexes. We use such relations to calculate the Smith normal form of the highest Laplacian matrix of simplicial annuli and $k$-trees. %The low dimensional cases seems to be more difficult to calculate.
